title: Getting Home Late and Eating Dinner Late: Can You Still Lose Weight?
intro: Yes, you can still lose weight even if you often eat dinner late. The amount and type of food throughout the day matter more than what time you eat.

sections.h: The real problem isn't the clock
sections.p: What usually causes trouble is reaching home very hungry after a long time in traffic. At that point, it's easy to overdo the rice, fried food or order a big delivery meal. So the main focus is not letting yourself get too hungry before heading home.

Eat a small snack around 5pm or before getting into traffic. For example, a banana and a boiled egg, yogurt or bread with nuts. When you get home, you'll still be hungry but calmer when choosing food.

Choose a menu with protein and vegetables, with half to one scoop of rice. For example, chicken soup, grilled fish, telur dadar with vegetables fried in a little oil, or tomyam with less santan. If you tapau from a warung, ask for gravy on the side and add vegetables.

Cook one pot of protein lauk like ayam masak kicap or boil eggs on the weekend. Keep cut vegetables in the fridge. When you get home late, you just need to heat things up and it's ready in 10 minutes.

If you can, leave a 1-2 hour gap between eating and sleeping so your stomach feels more comfortable. This especially helps if you easily get heartburn or bloating. If you get home very late, choose a smaller meal that's easy to digest.

action: Bring one snack to eat before you get into traffic every workday.
Prepare one protein lauk on the weekend for 2-3 nights.
When you order delivery, add one vegetable and cut the rice by half.
Sit and eat at the table, not in front of the TV or while scrolling your phone.
Note the time you get home and your hunger level for 5 days to find a pattern.
myth: Many believe eating after 7pm turns straight into fat. Actually, your body doesn't count the hours, what matters more is the amount of food throughout the day and being consistent every week.

faq.q: If I get home at 10pm, should I skip dinner?
faq.a: No need to skip. Eat a smaller meal with protein and vegetables, for example chicken soup with half rice, or eggs with vegetables. Skipping meals usually makes you hungrier the next day.

faq.q: I work shifts. Are these tips still suitable?
faq.a: Yes, the principle is the same. Treat the time you wake up as your 'morning' and plan your main meals and snacks around your work hours, not the usual clock.

faq.q: How fast can I lose weight if I follow these tips?
faq.a: A realistic target is an estimated 0.5-1 kg a week, but everyone is different. If you have PCOS, a thyroid problem or another health condition, get your doctor's advice for more accurate guidance.
